name: Post-graduation new-high acceptance
hypothesis: Buy after a completed post-graduation window holds above the old high with independent net inflow.
spec: Setup: Sustained trading above the pre-migration high may indicate fresh price discovery. Entry: Buy after a completed post-graduation window holds above the old high with independent net inflow. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on sustained return below the old high or flow reversal. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad migration events and pool state history (on-chain, not connected)
